name: 99-strength
description: 99 Strength: phone-first training planner (A2S2 + Hevy, cardio, mobility, habits)

scripts.start: npm run start:db && concurrently --kill-others -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
scripts.e2e: concurrently --kill-others --success first -n web,e2e -c green,yellow "npm run start:web" "npm run e2e:test"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.setup: npm run setup:db && npm run setup:api && npm run setup:web
